name: Brute Force Attack
description: Detects and responds to brute force attacks against SSH, RDP, or web authentication endpoints.
soar_integration: Splunk alert triggers SOAR playbook which creates this TheHive case, enriches source IPs, and executes block actions upon confirmation.

tasks.title: Triage: Validate Alert
tasks.description: Review source IP(s), targeted service, targeted username(s), and total attempt count.

tasks.title: Investigation: Check IP Reputation
tasks.description: Check reputation of source IP(s) against threat intelligence sources.

tasks.title: Investigation: Verify Successful Logins
tasks.description: Search authentication logs for any successful login from the same IP(s).

tasks.title: Decision: Malicious or Benign
tasks.description: If IP reputation score is high OR successful login found: MALICIOUS. Otherwise: FALSE POSITIVE.

tasks.title: Response: Block Source IP
tasks.description: Block the malicious source IP at firewall and/or WAF level.

tasks.title: Response: Lock Targeted Account
tasks.description: If successful login detected, disable the targeted user account.

tasks.title: Response: Add IP to Threat Intel
tasks.description: Submit confirmed malicious IP to internal threat intelligence platform.

tasks.title: Closure: Document and Close
tasks.description: Record final classification, actions taken, MITRE T1110, and lessons learned.

name: Phishing Email Incident
description: Handles phishing email reports submitted by users or detected by email security gateway.
soar_integration: SOAR playbook triggered by email gateway alert extracts URLs and file hashes, creates this TheHive case, and initiates enrichment and quarantine workflows.

tasks.title: Triage: Collect Email Artifacts
tasks.description: Extract sender address, all URLs, attachment hashes, email headers (SPF/DKIM/DMARC).

tasks.title: Investigation: Analyze URLs
tasks.description: Check all extracted URLs against threat intelligence and URL reputation services.

tasks.title: Investigation: Analyze Attachments
tasks.description: Submit attachment file hashes for reputation lookup and sandbox analysis.

tasks.title: Investigation: Assess User Impact
tasks.description: Determine if recipient clicked links or opened attachments.

tasks.title: Decision: Malicious or Benign
tasks.description: If URL or attachment confirmed malicious OR user clicked: MALICIOUS. Otherwise: FALSE POSITIVE.

tasks.title: Response: Quarantine Email
tasks.description: Remove phishing email from all affected mailboxes.

tasks.title: Response: Contain Affected User Endpoint
tasks.description: If user clicked, isolate endpoint, reset credentials, revoke sessions.

tasks.title: Response: Block Malicious Indicators
tasks.description: Block URLs and domains at web proxy and DNS level.

tasks.title: Closure: Notify and Document
tasks.description: Notify affected users, record MITRE T1566, close case.

name: Malicious IP Activity
description: Responds to detection of communication with known or suspected malicious IP addresses.
soar_integration: Splunk correlation rule detects traffic to flagged IP, SOAR creates this TheHive case and checks IP reputation automatically.

tasks.title: Triage: Identify Communication Details
tasks.description: Record source/destination IPs, ports, protocol, data volume, timestamps.

tasks.title: Investigation: Check IP Reputation
tasks.description: Query flagged IP against threat intelligence sources.

tasks.title: Investigation: Identify Affected Host
tasks.description: Identify internal host initiating suspicious traffic.

tasks.title: Investigation: Analyze Traffic Pattern
tasks.description: Determine if traffic matches C2 beaconing, exfiltration, or scanning.

tasks.title: Decision: Malicious or Benign
tasks.description: If IP confirmed malicious AND host shows compromise signs: MALICIOUS.

tasks.title: Response: Block Malicious IP
tasks.description: Block IP at firewall and endpoint level.

tasks.title: Response: Investigate Affected Host
tasks.description: Perform forensics on affected host.

tasks.title: Response: Add IoCs to Threat Intel
tasks.description: Submit confirmed malicious IP and associated indicators.

tasks.title: Closure: Document and Close
tasks.description: Record MITRE T1071, full timeline, affected assets.

name: Suspicious Login / Account Compromise
description: Investigates anomalous authentication events such as logins from unusual geolocations or outside business hours.
soar_integration: SOAR playbook triggered by SIEM alert on anomalous login creates this TheHive case and enriches source IP and user context.

tasks.title: Triage: Review Login Details
tasks.description: Collect login timestamp, source IP, geolocation, device, authentication method.

tasks.title: Investigation: Check Source IP
tasks.description: Verify reputation and geolocation of source IP.

tasks.title: Investigation: Verify User Activity
tasks.description: Review all actions performed by account after suspicious login.

tasks.title: Investigation: Check for Credential Exposure
tasks.description: Verify if credentials appeared in known data breaches.

tasks.title: Decision: Compromised or Legitimate
tasks.description: Contact user directly to confirm. If denied OR impossible travel: COMPROMISED.

tasks.title: Response: Disable Account and Revoke Sessions
tasks.description: Disable account, revoke all sessions and OAuth tokens.

tasks.title: Response: Contain and Investigate Endpoint
tasks.description: Isolate endpoint, perform forensic review.

tasks.title: Response: Notify and Remediate
tasks.description: Notify user, manager, IT team. Enable MFA.

tasks.title: Closure: Document and Close
tasks.description: Record MITRE T1078, root cause, full timeline.

name: False Positive Handling
description: Structured workflow for reviewing, validating, and closing alerts determined to be false positives.
soar_integration: SOAR routes low-confidence alerts to this TheHive case when initial checks indicate benign activity.

tasks.title: Triage: Review Alert Context
tasks.description: Review rule name, trigger conditions, involved entities, and raw log data.

tasks.title: Investigation: Validate Entities
tasks.description: Check entities against internal whitelists and known business processes.

tasks.title: Investigation: Check Historical Pattern
tasks.description: Search SIEM for historical occurrences of same alert for same entity.

tasks.title: Decision: Confirm False Positive
tasks.description: If activity fully explained by legitimate operations: FALSE POSITIVE. If doubt: escalate.

tasks.title: Response: Apply Suppression or Tuning
tasks.description: Create suppression rule in SIEM to prevent recurrence.

tasks.title: Response: Update Whitelist
tasks.description: Add confirmed safe entity to appropriate internal whitelist.

tasks.title: Closure: Document and Close
tasks.description: Record rationale, suppression action, improvement recommendations.
